content: In computational linguistics, morpheme is the basic unit of languages as Leonard Bloomfield mentioned for English BIBREF11 . In our research for Vietnamese, we consider the morpheme as syllable, called “tiếng” in Vietnamese (as Nguyen’s definition BIBREF12 ).
